articles.title: AI is making crypto security cheaper, faster and harder to ignore
articles.snippet: As AI-powered security tools become cheaper, faster and more widely available, researchers said they could reshape what the crypto industry considers reasonable due diligence before deploying code, potentially altering expectations for developers and institutions.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Trading the bitcoin cycle
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s 4-year cycle makes DCA costly. Learn why a cycle-smart strategy is essential for advisors to better manage volatility and maximize client returns.

articles.title: Bitcoin tipped for $66K top as trader flags 'suspicious' BTC price gains
articles.snippet: Bitcoin pushed for a $64,000 reclaim despite the US-Iran war making a partial comeback and Binance spot sellers keeping up pressure from earlier in the week.

articles.title: $13B Bitcoin options expiry looms: Will bulls endure more pain in June?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin bears hold the upper hand in the upcoming Bitcoin options expiry, a potentially early warning that more BTC downside could unfold.

articles.title: House Republican Introduces Insider Trading Bill to Ban Lawmaker Prediction Market Bets
articles.snippet: The bill is meant to curb potential insider trading, blocking lawmakers and family members from policy-related prediction market bets.
